quotes.text: Azure Virtual Desktop is Windows and Windows applications delivered from the cloud to any device. Think of it like a streaming service, but instead of streaming movies and TV shows, you're streaming your work desktop and business applications.

takeaways: Azure Virtual Desktop delivers Windows desktops and apps from Azure to any device through the Windows App, with Windows multi-session letting several users share one virtual machine.
Host pools, application groups and workspaces are the core building blocks, while Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access and the Virtual Machine User Login role control who can connect.
Start with a pooled host pool, depth-first load balancing and autoscaling for cost efficiency, use FSLogix for profiles from day one and assign access through groups rather than individual users.
hook: Buying, imaging and securing a laptop for every employee is slow and expensive, and remote work made it riskier. This episode explains Azure Virtual Desktop for IT admins and decision-makers: host pools, application groups, workspaces, Entra ID sign-in, FSLogix profiles and how autoscaling cuts costs.
